senses.gloss: क्षीर- + अब्धि क्षीर- + अब्धि, m. the sea of milk, Kathās. 22, 186.
क्षीर- + अम्बुधि क्षीर- + अम्बुधि, m. he sea of milk, Kathās. 17, 8.
क्षीण- + आयुस् क्षीण- + आयुस् (vb. क्षि), adj. lifeless, Sāv. 2, 23.
क्षिति- + ईश क्षिति- + ईश, m. a king, Ragh. 2, 67.
क्षिति- + ईश्वर क्षिति- + ईश्वर, m. a king, Ragh. 3, 3.
क्षीर- + उदधि क्षीर- + उदधि, m. the sea of milk, MBh. 12, 12778.
क्षीर- + ऊर्मि क्षीर- + ऊर्मि, a wave of the sea of milk, Ragh. 4, 27.
क्षीरौदन क्षीरौदन, [] i. e. क्षीर-, m. rice boiled with milk, MBh. 13, 947.
क्षिति-, भू- + कम्प क्षिति-, भू- + कम्प and भूमि-, m. an earthquake, MBh. 7, 7867; Rām. 1, 41, 15.

1. क्षि क्षि, i. 6, क्षिय (ved. ii. 2), Par.
 1. To dwell (ved.). 2. † To go.
 --With the prep. आ आ, ii. 2, To acquire, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13.
 --Cf. κτι in ἐΰκτιτος, ἐϋκτίμενος, κτίζω; perhaps Lat. civis, etc., so-cius, cf. सखि.

2. क्षि क्षि, i. 1, क्षय, Par. To possess; to rule (with gen.), Chr. 296, 3 = Rigv. i. 112, 3.
 --Cf. κτάομαι, κτέανον, κτέαρ, κτῆνος.

3. क्षि क्षि, ii. 9, क्षिणा, क्षिणी, ii. 5, क्षिणु, i. 1, क्षय, Par.
 1. To destroy, Ragh. 2, 40.
 2. To hurt, MBh. 3, 1355.
 3. To oppress, Man. 9, 315.
 --Pass. क्षीय,
 1. To decrease Bhāg. P. 5, 22, 9.
 2. To become exhausted, Pañc. i. d. 181.
 3. To disappear, Bhartṛ. 2, 16.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.,
 I. क्षीण,
 1. Decreased, Śāk. d. 133; Bhartṛ. 2, 88.
 2. Thin, Śāk. d. 58, v. r.
 3. Exhausted, Hit. 1, 66; Pañc. i. d. 244; iv. d. 16 (of hunger). Feeble, Cāṇ. 99, in Monatsb. d. Berl. Ak. Hist. Phil. 1864, 413.
 4. Finished, Kathās. 5, 128.
 5. Perished, MBh. 2, 972.
 II. क्षित.
 --Comp.
 --Causal,
 I. क्षपय,
 1. To destroy, MBh. 3, 15163.
 2. To emaciate, Man. 5, 157.
 3. To pass away, MBh. 14, 2720.
 II. क्षयय in क्षयित,
 1. Destroyed, Megh. 54.
 2. Atoned, Bhag. 4, 30 (v. r. क्षपित).
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass., क्षययितव्य. To be destroyed, Rām. 6, 17, 4.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, pass., To disappear by degrees, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 21.
 --With अप अप in अपक्षित, Exhausted, Bhāg. P. 3, 11, 32.
 --With उप उप in उपक्षीण, Disappeared, Sāh. D. 17, 2.
 --With परि परि, To destroy, Bhāg. P. 3, 8, 20. Pass., To become poor, Hit. ii. d. 91, v. r. परिक्षीण,
 1. Diminished, Kathās. 25, 140.
 2. Weakened, Man. 7, 172.
 3. Indigent, Man. 8, 170.
 --With प्र प्र, pass., To perish, MBh. 2, 1468.
 प्रक्षीण,
 1. Destroyed, Bhāg. P. 6, 7, 23.
 2. Atoned, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 21. []
 --With वि वि, in विक्षित, Miserable, Rām. 3, 79, 46.
 --With सम् सम्, pass., To become exhausted, Bhartṛ. 3, 44.
 --Caus.
 1. क्षपय, To cause to fall off, Suśr. 2, 134, 3.
 2. Ptcple. pf. pass., क्षयित, Vanished, Rām. 2, 48, 29.
 --Cf. κτίννυμι (probably for κτειννυμι and original κτεισνυμι, cf. क्षेष्णु, Vop. 26, 44), ψίω; Lat. sitis, properly, exhaustion by thirst.
† क्षिण् क्षिण्, ii. 8, क्षिणु (cf. 3. क्षि), Par., Ātm., To hurt, to kill.

ऽक्षित् 2. क्षि + त्, Ruling, e. g. पृथिवी-, m. A king, Nal. 5, 4.
 मही-, m. The same, Chr. 5, 25.

क्षिति 1. क्षि + ति, f.
 1. An abode, Bhāg. P. 4, 9, 5.
 2. The earth, Bhartṛ. 3, 5.
 3. Land, Rājat. 5, 109.

क्षितिज क्षिति-ज (vb. जन्)
 I. adj. Sprung from the earth, Suśr. 1, 224, 9.
 II. m. A tree, Rām. 6, 76, 2.
क्षितिधर क्षिति-धर, m. A mountain, Bhartṛ. 2, 10.

क्षितिभृत् क्षिति-भृ + त्, m.
 1. A mountain, Ṛt. 6, 25.
 2. A king, Bhartṛ. 3, 59, v. r.
क्षितिरुह् क्षिति-रुह्, m. A tree, Bhartṛ. 3, 28.
क्षितिवृत्तिमन्त् क्षिति-वृत्ति + मन्त्, adj. Patient, like the earth, Bhāg. P. 4, 16, 7.

क्षिप् क्षिप्, i. 6, Par., Ātm. (i. 4, Ātm. only in a grammatical poem).
 1. To throw, Pañc. 210, 17; MBh. 1, 1126 (क्षिप्यतस्, pass., instead of क्षिप्यमाणस्य); (of arrows), MBh. 3, 1018.
 2. To move quickly, Mṛcch. 9, 19.
 3. To impel, Rām. 3, 58, 21.
 4. To pour, Yājñ. 1, 230.
 5. To disdain, Bhāg. P. 3, 15, 17.
 6. To slander, Man. 8, 312.
 7. To destroy, Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 14. []
 --Comp. partcple. of the pf. pass., तिर्यक्क्षिप्त, i. e. तिर्यञ्च्-, adj. (One part of the bones of a joint) being turned outward, Suśr. 1, 300, 8.
 --Caus. To cause to be thrown, Kathās. 13, 160.
 --With the prep. अति अति, अति-क्षिप्त, Dislocated, Suśr. 1, 300, 8.
 --With अधि अधि,
 1. To offend, Man. 4, 185.
 2. To humble, to surpass, Bhāg. P. 3, 28, 30.
 3. To prevent (a disease), Suśr. 2, 337, 8.
 --With अप अप, To remove, Rām. 3, 1, 24.
 --With अव अव,
 1. To cast down, MBh. 1, 1126.
 2. To cast off, Rām. 2, 37, 7.
 3. To slander, MBh. 2, 1337.
 4. To tender, to grant, MBh. 13, 3030.
 --With समव सम्-अव, To repel, MBh. 3, 15662.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To cast on, Pañc. 263, 20.
 2. To hit, Rām. 6, 78, 5.
 3. To pull, MBh. 4, 750.
 4. To rob, Vikr. d. 143.
 5. To throw down, Bhāg. P. 6, 12, 28.
 6. To expel, MBh. 3, 539.
 7. To set up, Kathās. 18, 121.
 8. To put in, MBh. 3, 3094.
 9. To neglect, MBh. 3, 16117.
 10. To insult, Man. 4, 141.
 --Caus. To cause to be overthrown, MBh. 3, 15733.
 --With पर्या परि-आ, To twine, Kumāras. 7, 14.
 --With व्या वि-आ,
 1. To put on, MBh. 3, 566.
 2. To discharge, to shoot off.
 3. To hit, MBh. 1, 1402.
 व्याक्षिप्त, Agitated, Rām. 6, 91, 3.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To accumulate, MBh. 1, 156.
 2. To repel, MBh. 3, 15662.
 3. To move violently, MBh. 3, 117.
 4. To expel, MBh. 2, 1019.
 5. To pull down, Rām. 3, 56, 50.
 6. To destroy, MBh. 1, 1253.
 7. To insult, MBh. 1, 1677.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To throw up, Man. 3, 90.
 2. To raise, MBh. 3, 11187; Pañc. 187, 21.
 3. To cast off, Bhāg. P. 4, 23, 17.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्,
 1. To throw up, MBh. 3, 436. []
 2. To lift up, MBh. 3, 11519.
 3. To expel, MBh. 3, 13972.
 4. To loosen, Rām. 5, 56, 140.
 5. To destroy, Rām. 5, 3, 69.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To cast on, Sāh. D. 66, 5.
 2. To set, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 34.
 3. To insult, Rām. 5, 11, 11.
 4. To hint, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 6.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To throw down, Rām. 3, 33, 20.
 2. To put down, Yājñ. 1, 103.
 3. To encamp, Rām. 2, 91, 5.
 4. To put, Yājñ. 1, 327.
 5. To pour, Pañc. 174, 14.
 6. To dispense, Man. 7, 101.
 7. To intrust, Man. 7, 59.
 8. To establish, Rām. 2, 51, 17.
 9. To cast off, MBh. 3, 14115.
 10. To repel, Hit. 91, 11.
 --Caus. To cause to be drawn up, Ragh. 7, 62.
 --With उपनि उप-नि, To put down, Man. 3, 224.
 --With प्रतिनि प्रति-नि, To put down again, MBh. 3, 15184.
 --With विनि वि-नि,
 1. To throw down, Rām. 5, 11, 12.
 2. To put down, Yājñ. 1, 231.
 3. To intrust, MBh. 1, 3545.
 4. To appoint, MBh. 3, 10403.
 --With निस् निस्,
 1. To put down, Rām. 1, 38, 21.
 2. To put in, MBh. 3, 14314.
 --With विनिस् वि-निस्,
 1. To inlay with, MBh. 13, 1444.
 2. To direct, MBh. 3, 14293.
 --With परा परा, पराक्षिप्त,
 1. Robbed, Bhāg. P. 5, 24, 18.
 2. Enraptured, Bhāg. 5, 2, 18.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To overlay, Rām. 2, 32, 35.
 2. To surround, Rām. 3, 61, 31.
 3. To embrace, Rām. 2, 30, 2.
 4. To fetter, Rām. 2, 72, 38.
 5. To put in, MBh. 1, 4205.
 सूर्यातप-परिक्षिप्त, Darted upon by the rays of the sun.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To cast, MBh. 3, 707.
 2. To put, Mṛcch. 50, 1.
 --Caus. To order to be put, MBh. 1, 5008.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, [] To cast, MBh. 13, 4609.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To cast in, MBh. 1, 7068.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To cast in different directions, Chr. 34, 10.
 2. To disperse, MBh. 1, 7022.
 3. To extend, MBh. 14, 1161.
 4. To let go (the string of a bow, MBh. 3, 15690; or the bow, Rām. 3, 70, 2, i. e. to shoot).
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To heap, Ragh. 1, 52.
 2. To destroy, Rām. 3, 43, 42.
 3. To constrain, Rām. 2, 40, 39.

 5. To abridge, MBh. 1, 51.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To contract, MBh. 5, 283; अभिसंक्षिप्त, Thrown at, MBh. 1, 5368.
 --With परिसम्, To surround, Rām. 5, 29, 20.
क्षिप्तचित्तता क्षिप्त-चित्त + ता, f. Absence of mind, MBh. 2, 241.

क्षिप्र क्षिप् + र,
 I. adj., f. रा, Quick, Man. 7, 179. Comparat. क्षेपीयंस्, superl. क्षेपिष्ठ.
 II. रम्, adv. Quickly, Rām. 1, 52, 21.
 III. रात्, adv. Directly, Kathās. 18, 280.
क्षिल्लिका क्षिल्लिका, f. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 289.

† क्षिव् क्षिव्, i. 1 and 4, क्षीव्य, Par. To spit.
 --If identical with Goth. speiwan; A.S. spiwan; Lat. spuo; κτύω; Sskr. क् stands for प्, see क्लोमन्.
 --Cf. ष्ठिव्.

क्षीव् क्षीव्, i. 1, Par. To spit; cf. क्षिव् and ष्ठिव्.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रक्षीवित, Intoxicated.
क्षीज् क्षीज्, i. 1, Par. To sound inarticulately, to groan.
क्षीण क्षीण, see 3. क्षि.
क्षीणता क्षीण + ता, f. Being damaged, Mṛcch. 47, 3.
क्षीब् क्षीब्, and क्षीब क्षीब, = क्षीव्, क्षीव, q. cf.
क्षीर क्षीर, Milk, Man. 5, 8.

क्षीरप क्षीर-प (vb. 1. पा), m.
 1. Drinking milk, MBh. 13, 646.
 2. A nurse-child, Suśr. 1, 129, 1.
क्षीरमय क्षीर + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of milk, represented by milk, Bhāg. P. 4, 18, 9.
क्षीरय क्षीरय, a denomin. derived from क्षीर, Par. To become like milk, Lass. 12, 19.

क्षीरिन् क्षीरिन्, i. e. क्षीर + इन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी, Abounding in milk, Yājñ. 1, 204; Man. 8, 246.
 II. m. A certain tree, Suśr. 1, 133, 16.
 III. f. इणी, A name of several plants, Suśr. 2, 67, 17.
क्षीव क्षीव् + अ, adj., f. वा, Intoxicated, Rām. 5, 60, 12.
क्षीवता क्षीव + ता, f. Intoxication, Kathās. 13, 10.
क्षिति- + देव क्षिति- + देव, m. a king, Bhāg. P. 3, 1, 12.
क्षिति- + देवता क्षिति- + देवता, f. a Brāhmaṇa, MBh. 13, 6451.
क्षिति- + धेनु क्षिति- + धेनु, f. the cow-like earth, Bhartṛ. 2, 38.
क्षीर- + नीर क्षीर- + नीर, n. water with milk, Lass. 12, 18.
क्षिति- + पति क्षिति- + पति, and क्ष्मा-, m. a king, Pañc. ii. d. 22; Rājat. 5, 59.
क्षिति- + पाल क्षिति- + पाल, m. a king, Ragh. 2, 51.
क्षीण- + फल क्षीण- + फल, (vb. क्षि), adj. fruitless, Pañc. ii. d. 102.
क्षीर- + भृत क्षीर- + भृत, adj. paid with milk, ib.
क्षीर- + वारिधि क्षीर- + वारिधि, m. the sea of milk, Kathās. 22, 188.
क्षीर- + वृक्ष क्षीर- + वृक्ष, m. the glomerous fig-tree, Ficus glomerata, Śāk. 54, 23.
क्षीर- + समुद्र क्षीर- + समुद्र, m. the sea of milk, Pañc. 44, 21.
क्षीर- + सागर क्षीर- + सागर, m. the sea of milk, Bhāg. P. 8, 5, 11.
